# meta

Metadata is key and value data attached at tenant, project, or instance scope that instances read at boot. Silo-wide metadata is operator surface and lives under system/meta.

## GET /v1/instances/{instance_id}/realized-meta

Operation `instance_realized_meta_view`.

The full realized metadata view for one instance: the precedence merge of the four stored scopes (Silo < Tenant < Project < Instance) with the computed system keys (`meta-data/*`, `triton/system/*`) layered on top, each leaf tagged with the scope it came from. See `IMDS_DESIGN.md` §1.5. RBAC: tenant-member of the instance's owning tenant.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [RealizedMetaEntry](schemas.md#realizedmetaentry)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/meta/{scope}/{scope_id}

Operation `meta_list`.

List every metadata entry stored at one scope. RBAC: tenant-member of the scope's owning tenant.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | path | yes | [CustomerMetaScope](schemas.md#customermetascope) |  |
| `scope_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [MetaEntry](schemas.md#metaentry)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/meta/{scope}/{scope_id}/affected

Operation `meta_affected_instance_list`.

The affected-instances reverse-index for one (scope, key) pair. Walks every instance under the request scope and partitions them by whether the request scope's value wins for that instance or a narrower scope's value shadows it. RBAC: same as `meta_list` at the request scope.

Used by the operator console's IMDS authoring surface to answer "if I edit here, what changes?" *before* the operator commits — see `IMDS_DESIGN.md` §1.5 and the admin v3 design chat.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | path | yes | [CustomerMetaScope](schemas.md#customermetascope) |  |
| `scope_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `key` | query | yes | string |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [AffectedInstancesResponse](schemas.md#affectedinstancesresponse)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/meta/{scope}/{scope_id}/entry

Operation `meta_entry_view`.

Read one metadata entry by key (query parameter). The key may contain `/` (`config/ntp-servers`, `state/active-color`, …), hence the query-string placement.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | path | yes | [CustomerMetaScope](schemas.md#customermetascope) |  |
| `scope_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `key` | query | yes | string |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [MetaEntry](schemas.md#metaentry)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## PUT /v1/meta/{scope}/{scope_id}/entry

Operation `meta_entry_update`.

Upsert one metadata entry. Returns the stored entry plus the scope's new generation counter (the realized-view cache key). Validation per `validate_meta_entry`: namespace + scope + value-type + byte-cap rules; `guest_writable=true` is only accepted on `guest/*` keys at instance scope.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | path | yes | [CustomerMetaScope](schemas.md#customermetascope) |  |
| `scope_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `key` | query | yes | string |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SetMetaRequest](schemas.md#setmetarequest)

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [SetMetaResponse](schemas.md#setmetaresponse)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/meta/{scope}/{scope_id}/entry

Operation `meta_entry_delete`.
